description: Oluswayiri lwe lulimi lw’Obuvanjuba bwa Afrika, olwogerwa abantu bukade na bukade okuva e Mombasa ne Zanzibar okutuuka e Kampala, Kigali ne Goma.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Lusoga courses (#129) from the Luganda text, with low confidence in Lusoga; needs a native-speaker review.

why.title: Olulimi lw’**Obuvanjuba bwa Afirika bwona.**
why.text: Oluswayiri lulimi lwa gwanga mu Kenya, Tanzania ne Uganda, era lwe lwogerwa mu by’obusuubuzi okuva ku lubalama lw’enyanja okutuuka e Congo. Luyige otambule, osuubule, ofune emikwano era owulire enyimba, okuva ku taarab okutuuka ku bongo flava.

cards.title: Eri abatambuze
cards.text: Tambula okuva e Mombasa okutuuka e Mwanza mu matatu, daladala oba ku kyombo.

cards.title: Ku mulimu
cards.text: Yogera ne bakozi bano n’abaguzi mu kitundu kyona.

cards.title: Eri abaagala okumanya
cards.text: Zuula ebika by’amanya, engero n’ebitontome by’oku lubalama eby’emyaka lukumi.

landing.audience: Aboogera Olusoga abatandika okuva ku ntandikwa: abatambuze, abasuubuzi n’abakozi mu Buvanjuba bwa Afrika, n’abayizi abaagala Oluswayiri.
landing.first: Okulamusa n’ekitiibwa, ab’omu maka, emere n’akatale, enamba n’esaawa, ebifo n’okutambula, awaka, enaku za wiiki n’obulamu, ekitundu ku kitundu.

cast.nakato: Omukulembeze wo, omuyizi ku yunivasite e Dar es Salaam
cast.mukasa: Atunda caayi ne capati e Mombasa
cast.jjajja: Dhaadha e Zanzibar adamu buli kimu n’olugero
cast.ssali: Omuvuzi wa matatu e Nairobi amanyi buli siteegi
cast.amara: Omuyizi wa siniya e Arusha ayagala bongo flava
cast.emma: Omugenyi okuva ebweru ayiga Oluswayiri nga iwe
